name: Vasavi
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Watters, Stephen. 2013. A Sociolinguistic Profile of the Bhils of Northern Dhule District. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2013-004. Dallas: SIL International. vi+125 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic survey (lexical similarity, intelligibility, bilingualism); Appendix C gives 210-item IPA wordlists for four Vasave villages (Kelpada, Dhanoura, Digiamba, Amoda) plus Bhilori, Noiri, Pauri and Nahali, with no stress marks (0 occurrences of IPA stress mark in the text layer). Confirms identity: 'What Grierson refers to as Dehwali is probably known to the researcher as Vasave' (section 1.2.1, citing LSI IX.iii:158).

sources.citation: Grierson, George A. 1907. Linguistic Survey of India, Vol. IX Part III: Indo-Aryan Family, Central Group: The Bhil Languages, including Khandesi, Banjari or Labhani, Bahrupia, &c. Calcutta: Office of the Superintendent of Government Printing. Section 'Dehawali', pp. 158-159 (PDF pp. 171-172 of the DLI scan;ernet.dli.2015.61830).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. The 'Pronunciation' paragraph on p. 158 (page image viewed) notes only 'the drawling pronunciation of final vowels and the free use of the Anunasika', treatment of short a, dropping of initial h, deaspiration, s > h, loss of intervocalic r, and the cerebral l; no word about accent or stress. The only accent remark in the volume is the generic transliteration note ('When it is necessary to mark an accented syllable, the acute accent is used'), not applied to Dehawali.

sources.citation: Vasava, Jitendra V. Dehvali bhilo ni maukhik kathaono ane sanskrutik ane sahityik abyas. PhD thesis (Gujarati). Shodhganga handle 10603/540206.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Gujarati folklore thesis on the Dehwali Bhils; Indian folklore theses sometimes open with a 'boli' (dialect) chapter listing sounds. Bitstreams were not downloadable at search time (HTTP 302).

sources.citation: WALS Online, language page 'Vasavi' (WALS code vas; Dryer & Haspelmath eds.)
sources.note: No phonological data: local WALS raw dump shows only four valuesets for vas (features 132A-135A, colour terms), no source of a grammar.

sources.citation: Bhāratīya bhāshāñce lokasarvekshaṇa: Mahārāshṭra (People's Linguistic Survey of India, Maharashtra volume), ed. Aruṇ Jākhaḍe. 2013. Pune: Padmagandhā Prakāśan. (Open Library OL23102225W) — check for a 'Dehwali'/'Vasavi' chapter
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: PLSI state volumes carry short community-written sketches with a sounds section for each tribal language; the Maharashtra volume is the likeliest place for a Dehwali/Vasavi sketch, though PLSI sketches rarely mention stress. Only the volume record was seen; the presence of a Vasavi chapter is unverified.

sources.citation: Rathwa, Chamulal & Subhash Pawra (eds. B. Syamala Kumari & S.S. Yadurajan). 2005. Dehwali Bhili pictorial glossary. Mysore: CIIL / Vadodara: Bhasha Research & Publication Centre. x+151 pp.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: Only lexical publication on the Dehwali (Vasavi) dialect; its English prefatory matter may contain a transcription/phonology note. Low expectation of a stress statement.

sources.citation: SIL India / Wycliffe (Mathew Varghese et al.) Vasavi language-development materials, e.g. an unpublished Vasavi phonology or orthography statement (only the 2006 booklet 'Chidaha navo rog' is listed publicly, oai:sil.org:283656)
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: SIL ran a Vasavi literacy/translation project (Devanagari and Gujarati scripts, Ethnologue status 5 Developing); such projects normally produce a phonological/orthographic write-up with a stress note, but none is in the public archive listing.

sources.citation: SIL Language & Culture Archives OAI harvest (2024-04-13) records for Vasavi [vas]: Watters 2013 (oai:sil.org:52641) and Varghese, Mathew (tr.) 2006 'Chidaha navo rog' (36 pp., SIL/WFA, oai:sil.org:283656)
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
sources.note: No SIL phonology or grammar write-up for Vasavi is listed publicly; only the survey and a literacy/health booklet.
